feature_definitions.prior_range_high: rolling high shifted by one bar; current bar is excluded
feature_definitions.range_reclaim: closed bar close reclaims prior range high after prior close was inside/below the prior range
feature_definitions.trend_confirmation: fast MA above slow MA, close above slow MA, slow MA slope positive
feature_definitions.volatility_filter: current realized volatility <= rolling historical quantile threshold

no_lookahead.feature_basis: rolling current-and-past OHLCV; prior range uses shift(1)
